gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hind-vadodara: Galaxy lays down a loud, cosmic line with generous space between letters. The best trick here is the partner below: Hind Vadodara, plain sans with rounded, wide-mouthed letters and a stroke that never changes thickness.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-huninn: Cosmic from the first glance, Galaxy spaces its uniform-width letters loosely and lets them stretch out. Huninn takes over with lowercase rising close to cap height and crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-inter-tight: Commanding, Galaxy spaces its uniform strokes loosely and stands apart from the text below. And Inter Tight, plain sans with bent-tubing lines and short ascenders, would read smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-karla: Karla reads stocky and approachable, its middle band so tall that lines look compact. And Galaxy brings marker-tip strokes with no modulation whatsoever, a loud foil for the gentle sans below.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri lifts its x-height skyward and keeps rounded letters open and inviting. But Galaxy does the shouting best, with marker-tip strokes and loose spacing, while the sans-serif body does the welcoming.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-khula: Galaxy arrives cosmic and commanding, its strokes completely unshaded and its letters spaced loosely across the line. Khula, plain sans with brush-pen belly and open curves, keeps paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-krub: Terminals and tails that carry the full stem weight give Galaxy its commanding, cosmic look. And where Galaxy demands attention, Krub, a sans with unfinished curves and a pronounced x-height, does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-kufam: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy lets its loosely spaced letters run in an unbroken stroke, while Kufam sets neon-tube lines beneath. Both keep a single track width, which links them.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-lexend: Loud, cosmic, commanding: Galaxy stretches its uniform strokes across wide, loose spacing. Lexend, the sans-serif below, has outsized lowercase, open jaws on every curve and a steady stroke.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca keeps its line plain and unshaded, with small-looking capitals beside big lowercase. Galaxy makes the loud entrance with loosely spaced cosmic strokes, while this sans simply gets on with the words.
